diagnose_build_ext_error: diagnose a build_ext compilation error by running C checks and reporting missing source files
diagnose_compile_error: diagnose a compilation error by checking for missing Python.h headers and Cython source files
diagnose_attribute_error: diagnose a missing _needs_stub attribute error caused by an outdated setuptools version
compile_c_source: compile a C source string using a distutils compiler in a temporary directory
expect_compile_success: expect a C source string to compile successfully and raise an error if it fails
